column1: # BOT-PANEL presets (docs/lanes/bot-panel.md): what each button of the dev "Bot Control" agent spawns.
# One row per roster row. Columns: preset  label  prefix  side  role  count  skills  ship  where
#   preset  the button's key; rows of one preset are issued together, in file order
#   label   the link text in the agent window (plain words, no tabs)
#   prefix  letters and digits; the group is <prefix><serial> (the serial is unique per press)
#   side    ally = the caller's side (bots join the caller's corporation); foe = a hostile side
#   role    a --loop role (roamgang is ROAM-GANG's: fan out, report, gather, engage together)
#   skills  all5 | role | a plan name;  ship a type NAME resolved by the bundle at run time, or -
#   where   here = the caller's system;  near1..near3 = a system up to that many jumps away
# Each row becomes: /bots spawn <group> <side word> <role> <count> <skills> <ship> <system id>
